text: ThemajorofElectronicand InformationEngineering has been enrolled since 2004. It has been listed as acharacteristic specialtyof the University in 2013, and approved as afirst-class professional construction sitein Zhejiang Province in 2019.This program constructs the professional curriculum system according to the national engineering education certification standards. The professional courses cover the field of electronic information. Students can not only learn the basic knowledge of electronic information, but also deeply study the embedded software and hardware, algorithm of signal acquisition, processing and transmission, automatic control technology and electronic hardware and software, etc. Relying on the provincial key construction of information technology experimental teaching demonstration center and the National and Provincial Discipline scientific research platform, the theoretical teaching and practical ability training can be carried out simultaneously which strengthens the engineering practice ability and innovation ability for. The graduates can be engaged in the design and development, operation and maintenance and management in the fields of electronic information industry.This major cultivates applied engineering and technical talents, who can meet the needs of social and economic development, serve the development needs of enterprises in the information industry, and can be engaged in the design, development, application, integration, testing, operation and maintenance and management in the fields of electronic technique, information and communication, industrial control, acquisition and processing of signal, computer application, and other aspects.The following objectives should be achieved:①Graduateshave good professional ethics and have a sense of social responsibility, dedication, safety and environmental awareness in work, and be able to actively serve the society.②Graduateshave rich and professional work experience, and have the ability to provide effective solutions for complex practical engineering problems in electronic information and related fields by comprehensively using the knowledge and skill in electronic information engineering and related disciplines.③Graduates areable to continuously track the cutting-edge technologies in electronic information engineering, be able to expand and innovate according to the need of the practical engineering, and apply these for the innovation development and industrial upgrading in electronic information field.④Graduateshave a healthy body and mind, have the coordination and communication ability, project manage ability and economic decision-making ability, and act as backbone or leader in a team.⑤Graduates areable to persistently upgrade knowledge or engineering ability and improve the social work ability or professional technology standardby continuing education or other lifelong learning sources.
